focus_areas: Limb counting and joint articulation via VLM inspection
Distinctness of individual crab instances in the pile
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Focus heavily on the limb anatomy using visual inspection. AI generators frequently struggle with the exact number of legs on crustaceans (often generating 6 or 8 instead of 5 pairs) or fusing legs together in pile compositions. Verify that the dark tips on the claws are distinct and not bleeding into the white shell. Check if the ice texture looks physically distinct from the crab shells or if there is 'melting' where they touch. Do NOT attempt to use skeletal keypoints; rely on semantic segmentation boundaries and visual counting.
image_description: A high-angle, close-up shot of a pile of cooked Dungeness crabs resting on crushed ice. The crabs are oriented in various directions, primarily displaying their ventral (underside) surfaces which are cream to orange-white in color. Several robust claws with dark tips and multiple walking legs are visible extending from the bodies. The scene suggests a seafood market or display setting.
